title: Coded authentication failures
responsibility: Create stable authentication error codes with their mapped HTTP status.

inputs.name: AuthFailure.constructor.code
inputs.description: The stable authentication failure code used by the constructor. Its `AuthFailureCode` value selects the HTTP status from the local status table.

inputs.name: authFail.code
inputs.description: The stable authentication failure code passed to `authFail`. Its `AuthFailureCode` value selects the HTTP status from the local status table.

outputs.name: authFail
outputs.description: This function has no return value; it throws an `AuthFailure` carrying the supplied code, generic message, and mapped HTTP status.

errors.name: AuthFailure
errors.description: The function throws an `Error` named `AuthFailure` with the supplied code, status selected from the local table, and message `Hub auth ${code}`. The message does not include provider detail.
